standard.summary: 填写希望 LoRA 少学习或少强化的内容，例如 bad hands
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Fill in what you want the LoRA to learn or reinforce less of, bad hands for example
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 填写希望 LoRA 少学习或少强化的内容，例如 bad hands、watermark、extra fingers。留空时不会生效。

advanced_en.principle: Fill in what you want the LoRA to learn or reinforce less of, e.g. bad hands, watermark, extra fingers. No effect when empty.
